svg.text: ZERO-CLOUD EDITION · every lesson, voice, lexicon and worksheet engine ships INSIDE the app · no server, no sync branch, no network decision
measured engine heap 5.8 MB · 0.6 ms avg per translation · APK 18.5 MB on disk · builds dated 2026-09-09
Ol Chiki · Devanagari · Warang Chiti render on-device
TEACHER OPENS SARJOM — airplane mode is perfectly fine
SERVICE WORKER BOOT — THE TABLET IS THE SERVER
App shell, 4-language lexicon, native audio bank, Ol Chiki & Warang Chiti fonts, worksheet / flashcard / ORF engines:
all served from THIS tablet's CacheStorage. navigator.onLine is never checked — there is no online branch and no cloud twin.
District & school stored on device (Dumka · West Singhbhum · Khunti) · UDISE code · dialect auto-tune: Santhali · Ho · Mundari · Sadri
QR is a bonus, not a dependency
ENCRYPTED LOCAL COMMIT — ZERO UPLOAD PATH EXISTS
Scores, badges, ORF marks, worksheet & flashcard logs are written to THIS tablet's localStorage / CacheStorage only.
No sync queue, no cloud tenant, no API keys. New lessons, voices and lexicon updates arrive as a NEW APP BUILD (USB install or demo-link update).
READY FOR NEXT LESSON — 100% OF SARJOM LIVES ON THIS DEVICE
HONEST DEVICE BUDGET — 2 GB ANDROID 9 TABLET (MEASURED, NOT MARKETING)
OS + SYSTEM + BACKGROUND APPS ≈ 1,500 MB [typical device state]
SARJOM HEAP 5.8 MB [measured] = 1% OF FREE RAM

On disk: APK 18.5 MB · native studio audio bank 0.73 MB · JS bundle 166 kB gzip | Speed: 0.6 ms avg · 1.58 ms p95 · 1.83 ms p99 per translation (SLA 3,000 ms) | Benchmark: node benchmark_memory_and_latency.cjs
